title: Colorful Spanning Tree
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 6 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 150; N - 1 \leq M \leq \min\left(\frac{C N (N-1)}{2}, 5 \times 10^5\right); 1 \leq C \leq 300; 1 \leq A_i \leq N-1; \sum_{i=1}^C A_i \leq 300; 1 \leq u_i < v_i \leq N; 1 \leq c_i \leq C; If i \neq j, then (u_i, v_i, c_i) \neq (u_j, v_j, c_j); The given graph is connected.; All input values are integers.
